liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Let It Grow** (2 reviews): Reviewer calls it possibly the best ever and one of Jerry's finest performances of that year; Reviewer calls this version splendid [15][26]
- **Little Red Rooster** (1 review): Reviewer finds Weir's slide solo laughably bad [16]
- **Stagger Lee** (1 review): Well performed, but the very clean audio removes some of its gritty charm [16]
- **Me and My Uncle** (1 review): Features Jerry on the lead [16]
- **All Along The Watchtower** (1 review): Reviewer says Bob's gritty, pirate-like vocals here drew them to the Dead after finding it on Napster [17]
- **Don't Ease Me In** (1 review): Reviewer finds its placement in the set interesting [26]

## Setlist highlights

- **gd87-10-02 t01 Crowd**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [27]
- **gd87-10-02 t02 Cold Rain & Snow**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [27]
- **gd87-10-02 t03 Little Red Rooster**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [27]
- **gd87-10-02 t04 Stagger Lee**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [27]
- **gd87-10-02 t05 Me & My Uncle**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [27]
- **gd87-10-02 t06 Mexicali Blues**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [27]
- **gd87-10-02 t07 Row Jimmy**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [27]
- **gd87-10-02 t08 Far From Me**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [27]

## The recordings

- **gd1987-10-02.142333.fob.schoeps.cmc4.mk41.oade.jacobs.miller.clugston.flac1644** (recommended): audience recording; 22 songs; 144 min; rated 4/5 by 1 [1]
- **gd1987-10-02.pzm.russjcan.94115.sbeok.flac16**: source not stated; 21 songs; 125 min; rated 3/5 by 1 [2]. Said about its sound: Decent audience-style recording; Jerry's guitar sits a bit low in the mix [19]
- **gd1987-10-02.sbd.walker-scotton.miller.83905.sbeok.flac16**: soundboard; 20 songs; 140 min; rated 4.25/5 by 4 [3]. Said about its sound: Remaster sounds nice, with slight tape hiss in quiet passages; Soundboard has some mixing quirks that intrude only slightly [21][23]
- **gd1987-10-02.sbd.miller.121960.flac16**: soundboard; 20 songs; 141 min; rated 3/5 by 5 [4]. Said about its sound: Sound is quite good for such a large open-air amphitheatre [24]
- **gd87-10-02.sbd.bertha-ashley.7367.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 20 songs; 140 min; rated 2.57/5 by 7 [5]. Said about its sound: Soundboard recording described as having good sound [15]
- **gd1987-10-02.sbd.tunakebo.6938.shnf**: soundboard; 20 songs; 140 min [6]. Said about its sound: Brief dropout in Cold Rain and Snow around the 1:30 mark [6]
- **gd1987-10-02.165068.sbd.cm.miller.t-flac1644**: soundboard; 20 songs; 144 min [7]
- **gd1987-10-02.163714.sbd.miller-walker.flac2496**: soundboard; 20 songs; 144 min [8]

## Around the show

- Venue had a big crowd, steeply sloped lawn, spotty sound, and a landfill smell in early years [19]
- Sound is not bad by 1987 standards [26]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1987-10-02.142333.fob.schoeps.cmc4.mk41.oade.jacobs.miller.clugston.flac1644**: taped by Oade Brothers; transferred by Scott Clugston and Charlie Miller and Blake Jacobs; source: Source Info: Oade's Master (FOB) Audience PCM; Schoeps CMC4/MK41mics > Oade M118 > Oade modified Sony PCM-F1; Transfer Info: Master Oade PCM > Sek'd Prodif >… [1]
- **gd1987-10-02.pzm.russjcan.94115.sbeok.flac16**: taped by Russ Cansler; transferred by Russ Cansler; source: Hat mounted realistic pzm's with Sony WMD6-C 100 feet away ,right of center section 201 row M seat16 Maxell MX 90 Cnr [2]
- **gd1987-10-02.sbd.walker-scotton.miller.83905.sbeok.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> Cassette Master (Maxell MX90) D [3]
- **gd1987-10-02.sbd.miller.121960.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> Cassette Master (Maxell MX90) [4]
- **gd87-10-02.sbd.bertha-ashley.7367.sbeok.shnf**: source: Jay Ashley (Bertha) remaster of master cassette source (that had been transferred by Keith Bode) [5]
- **gd1987-10-02.sbd.tunakebo.6938.shnf**: transferred by Keith Bode; source: SBD>CM>DAT>WAV(Ego Sys U2A, Cool Edit Pro)>CD [6]
- **gd1987-10-02.165068.sbd.cm.miller.t-flac1644**: taped by Recorded by Joani Walker -- Tapes supplied by Paul Scotton; transferred by All Transfers and Mastering by Charlie Miller  February 16, 2023; source: SBD > Cassette Master (Sony TC-D5M/Maxell MX90) [7]. Also: Tapes from Paul Scotton; several soundboard masters combined for completeness, with pitch correction settings from Joe B. Jones [7]
- **gd1987-10-02.163714.sbd.miller-walker.flac2496**: taped by Joani Walker; transferred by All Transfers and Mastering by Charlie Miller  February 16, 2023; source: SBD > Cassette Master (Sony TC-D5M/Maxell MX90) [8]. Also: Tapes from Paul Scotton; multiple soundboard masters used to complete the show, with pitch correction settings from Joe B. Jones [8]
